subject: health
concept: Evaluating the genuine tradeoffs involved in public health policies that balance individual freedom against collective wellbeing
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's evenhandedness principle — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a public health policy to a tradeoff it involves between individual choice and collective benefit

misconception_flags: presents a public health policy as having no genuine tradeoff whatsoever

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
